attributes.name: Ekram Iffek
attributes.powers:
Before you act, you may draw a random non-Basic item from the box. If you do, Ekram Iffek is evaded; shuffle him into the location deck listed after the deck he came from on the scenario's deck list. (If he came from the last location on the list, shuffle him into the first location on the list.)

If you succeed at a combat check to defeat Ekram Iffek, draw the loot Natron Fang.
